checks: Real procurement RFQ with normalized clarification cutoff; frozen supplier promise sends only after account-owned action approval via QEP; fixed-time coverage deterministic with zero read writes and no other-bidder exposure

Accepted colleague response remains pinned after workspace switch; actual independent signed order supports exact currency amount and matched approval wait; print preserves lines/revisions/hash anchors while removing private quote fields and escaping HTML; report/CSV/TXT/print share one read-only source calculation; later acknowledgments do not recount orders and retrospective overdue excludes later responses
Restart replays operational promises, receipts and reminders; mounted plugin disposal removes services/routes/tools/schema/policy and scheduler performs no later writes
